errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the blue line to values on the right y-axis (8000), but the blue line uses the left y-axis (0-1000).
The purple line (Handelspolitik) surges to approximately 2000 in 2020, not 7000 in 2021.
The purple line rises to approximately 8000 by 2024, but this occurs after 2023, not as a 'sharp' rise from 2023 to 2024 as implied.
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate the development of economic policy indices over time.
The description omits that the black and blue lines remain relatively constant from 2016 to 2020 before their peaks.
The description does not mention that the purple line falls back to 0 in 2021 after its initial peak.
